Multiple charges cannot be gained at once.

items.name: Abyss
items.description: Destroys all item pedestals in the room and gives Isaac a unique locust familiar for each item destroyed. Locusts fly forwards in the direction Isaac shoots and damage enemies hit. Destroying certain items spawns special locusts with unique effects.
effects: On use, destroys all items on item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust familiar for each item destroyed.
These locusts are permanent once created, up to a maximum of 64, after which creating more will replace older locusts.
The locusts loosely orbit Isaac similarly to regular Blue Flies, charging in the direction Isaac is firing until hitting an enemy, wall, or certain obstacles like key blocks.
The damage locusts deal is a multiplier of Isaac's damage and dependent on the quality of the item destroyed (2-3 times per hit):
The locusts may gain additional effects depending on the item destroyed.

items.name: A Quarter
items.description: Gives Isaac 25 Pennys.
effects: Gives Isaac 25 Penny.

items.name: Azazel's Rage

effects: Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.
After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large Brimstone laser for ~3.33 seconds.

items.name: 9 Volt
items.description: Reduces the charge of any activated item by 1. Any 1 charge items instead have timed recharges.
effects: Fully charges the currently held active item upon 9 Volt's first pickup.
If the current active item has a recharge time of more than 1 bar, then it will grant 1 bar of charge whenever the item is activated.

If the current active item has a recharge time of 1 bar, then it will change the item to have a timed recharge of 15 seconds. The recharging of the item only triggers so long as there are enemies present in the room in any fashion. Empty rooms do not cause recharging to start.
If the current activated item already has a timed recharge, 9 Volt makes it start at half charge when used, effectively halving the time to recharge and allowing quicker reuse.

items.name: 3 Dollar Bill
items.description: Gives Isaac a random tear effect every room. Gives Isaac a random tear effect every few seconds.
effects: Grants Isaac random tear effects. The possible effects are: {{column list | width = 15em | content =
The type of randomized tear is determined upon entering a room.
The type of randomized tear changes every 6 seconds. The item appears to select two tear effects at once, perhaps staggering the times at which each of those effects change.
While not directly a tear effect, 3 Dollar Bill may rotate through Magneto and Lucky Foot, which may be used to take only positive pills.

items.name: A Snack
items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

effects: Adds a chance to shoot slowing tears, reducing the speed of enemy movement and any projectiles they fire.
Isaac leaves a trail of slowing Black creep.

items.name: Anarchist Cookbook
items.description: Spawns six Troll Bombs around the room.
effects: Spawns 6 Troll Bombs, generally near the center of the room.
Counts toward the Bookworm transformation.

items.name: Bag of Crafting
items.description: Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.
effects: Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage.
Swiping a pickup on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored.
Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal.
There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome.

If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite.
Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory.
As The Lost, Birthright prevents items with the nolostbr item tag from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting.
As Tainted Lost, items without the offensive item tag will not appear.

items.name: Almond Milk
items.quote: DMG down + tears up + you feel nutty
items.description: Quadruples fire rate, with ×0.3 damage multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.
effects: Quadruples fire rate.
×0.3 damage multiplier.
-0.16 tear size.

items.description: The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.
effects: When Isaac takes damage, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor.

items.name: Blood Bombs
items.description: Grants a Red Heart container and restores 5 hearts. Bombs leave behind damaging red creep. Isaac can place Bombs at the cost of half a heart if he doesn't have any.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Restores 4 Red Hearts.
Causes Isaac's Bombs to leave a pool of red creep on the ground when they explode.
If Isaac has no bombs, allows him to place a bomb at the cost of taking half a heart of damage. This prioritizes Red Hearts over Soul Hearts.

items.name: Berserk!
items.description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.
effects: Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply:
This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.

items.name: Bot Fly
items.description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.
effects: Spawns a robotic Pooter familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.
Counts toward the Beelzebub transformation.

items.name: Blue Map
items.description: Reveals the locations of Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms on the map.
effects: Reveals the locations of Secret Rooms and Super Secret Rooms on the map.

items.name: Box of Friends
items.description: Duplicates all of Isaac's familiars for the current room. If Isaac has no familiars, spawns a Demon Baby for the room instead.
effects: Upon use, it adds one copy of each of Isaac's familiars for the duration of the current room.
If Isaac has no familiars, a Demon Baby will spawn for the duration of the current room.

items.name: Big Fan
items.description: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 30 damage per second to enemies. Reduces the speed other orbitals rotate at.
effects: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 2 damage per tick (~8.57 damage per second) on contact.
Reduces the rotation speed of all of Isaac's orbitals. This excludes Pretty Flies.
Counts toward the Beelzebub transformation.

items.name: Best Friend
items.description: Spawns a decoy Isaac that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies will always target the decoy and ignore Isaac.
effects: Spawns a decoy vaguely resembling Isaac in his crying animation, which explodes after 5 seconds with the blast radius of a Mega Troll Bomb.
The decoy bomb distracts enemies, as they will target the decoy instead of Isaac regardless of distance.

items.name: Boom!
items.description: Grants 10 Bombs.
effects: Grants 10 Bombs.

items.name: Bird Cage
items.description: The first time Isaac takes damage in a room, a familiar leaps on an enemy, dealing damage and releasing a rock wave. For the rest of the room, it chases enemies similar to Dead Bird.
effects: Gives Isaac a fat bird familiar that sits on Isaac's head until he takes damage.

Upon taking damage, it will jump off of Isaac's head and land on the nearest enemy, dealing damage and creating a rock line in a random direction. For the rest of the room, it acts like Dead Bird, flying around, albeit slower, and dealing contact damage to enemies.

items.name: Broken Modem
items.description: Enemies, enemy shots, tears, and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals. The reward from clearing a room will sometimes be duplicated.
effects: Enemies, enemy shots, tears and pickups will briefly freeze in place at random intervals.
Room clear rewards have a 25% chance to spawn a duplicate, except for chests, pills, or cards.

items.name: Brother Bobby
items.description: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears 1.88 times a second that each do 3.5 damage.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires normal tears 1.88 times a second that each do 3.5 damage.
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: Butter Bean
items.description: Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies and projectiles. Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.
effects: Upon use, Isaac farts and knocks back nearby enemies.

items.name: Chaos
items.description: Drops 1-6 random pickups on the floor. Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.
effects: Drops 1-6 random pickups around Isaac.
Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.

items.name: Chocolate Milk
items.description: Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.
effects: Grants charged tears that deal greater damage when fully charged.

items.name: Car Battery
items.description: Causes Isaac's activated item to activate twice on each use.
effects: Causes eligible activated items to activate twice on each use.

items.name: Champion Belt
items.description: +1 damage. Increases the chance of champion enemies appearing by 15%.
effects: +1 damage.
Increases the chance for champion enemies to appear by 15%.

items.name: Cancer
items.description: Adds 3 Soul Hearts. Grants The Wafer effect for the current room after taking damage.
effects: Grants three Soul Hearts.
After taking damage, grants The Wafer effect of damage reduction for the current room.

items.name: Consolation Prize
items.description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Penny, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.
effects: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts, depending on what attribute Isaac has the least of:
Also drops either 3 Penny, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key on the ground.
As Bethany and Tainted Bethany, one Soul Heart or two Red Hearts can also be dropped if they are low on charges.

items.name: Contract From Below
items.description: Doubles the number of most room clear awards, but reduces the overall chance of getting one by 1/3.
effects: Spawns N + 1 Room Clear Awards, but has a (0.666N / 2) chance to set the number of spawned pickups to 0, where N is the number of copies of this item held.

items.name: Cambion Conception
items.description: After taking damage a certain amount of times, a permanent demonic familiar spawns.
effects: Upon taking damage a certain number of times, Isaac gains a permanent demonic familiar. Possible familiars include:

The first and second familiars will each spawn after taking damage 15 times. The third and fourth familiars will each spawn after taking damage 30 more times. No further familiars will spawn. As a result, after taking damage 90 times, four out of eight possible familiars will have spawned.

items.name: Converter
items.description: Converts one Soul Heart or Black Heart into one filled Red Heart Container.
effects: Converts one Soul Heart or Black Heart into one filled Red Heart container.

items.name: Celtic Cross
items.description: Grants a chance to trigger the Book of Shadows effect upon taking damage, creating a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 7 seconds.
effects: Grants a chance to trigger the Book of Shadows effect upon taking damage, creating a shield that nullifies all types of damage for 7 seconds.

items.name: Continuum
items.description: Grants spectral tears and increases range. Tears travel through walls and appear at the opposite side of the room.
effects: Grants spectral tears.
When tears travel off-screen, they loop back around through the opposite wall.
+3 range.

items.name: Circle of Protection
items.description: Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo that occasionally deals Isaac's tear damage to enemies inside it, and can convert enemy shots into friendly homing tears.
effects: Surrounds Isaac with a large white halo.

items.name: Broken Watch
items.description: Slows all enemies in every fourth newly-discovered room, with a ~13% chance to speed them up instead.
effects: Every 4th newly discovered room, slows all enemies and their attacks down to half their normal speed, but has a ~13% chance of speeding them up by 40% instead.

items.name: Cat-o-nine-tails
items.description: +1 damage, +0.23 shot speed.
effects: +1 damage.
+0.23 shot speed.

items.name: Compound Fracture
items.description: Increases Range. Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 bone shards upon hitting an enemy or obstacle.
effects: Tears turn into bones, which shatter into 1-3 shards upon hitting an obstacle or enemy, which each deal 50% of Isaac's Damage.
+1.5 Range.

items.name: Censer
items.description: Spawns a familiar which creates a circular aura that slows down enemies and enemy shots inside.
effects: Spawns a familiar projecting a circular aura that slows enemies and enemy shots within its radius and for a short period once they exit.

items.name: Chemical Peel
items.description: Tears fired from the left eye have +2 flat damage.
effects: +2 flat damage to tears fired from Isaac's left eye.

items.name: Camo Undies
items.description: Isaac becomes camouflaged at the beginning of each room. Until he shoots, all non-boss enemies will be confused. Isaac gains +0.5 Speed while camouflaged, and gains Tears and Damage upon breaking it.
effects: Upon entering a new room, Isaac will become camouflaged and all enemies become confused. The effect will last until Isaac presses a fire button.

items.name: Breath of Life
items.description: Grants a brief moment of invincibility when the charge bar hits zero. Isaac begins taking damage if the item is held any longer. Isaac creates beams of light when touching enemies while invulnerable, and creates a powerful 4-way beam if blocking damage exactly as the invincibility starts.
effects: Holding the active item button will deplete the charge bar. As the charge gets closer to zero, Isaac turns bluer over time.

Once the charge bar hits zero, Isaac will become invincible to all outside sources of damage. If the button is held for an additional second after hitting zero, Isaac will take damage for every second the button is held down.
The item will recharge on its own, but cannot be used again until it is fully charged (even if the charge bar wasn't fully depleted).

items.name: Bum Friend
items.description: Spawns a familiar that picks up Penny for himself, giving random pickups in return. Can spawn items from the Beggar item pool.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac and picks up coins on the ground.
After picking up 6 coins, Bum Friend will return to Isaac and drop a pickup.
After that, Bum Friend has a 67% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 3 coins and a 33% chance to drop a pickup after picking up 4 coins.
Counts toward the Super Bum transformation.

items.name: Charm of the Vampire
items.description: Heals Isaac for a Half Red Heart for every 13 enemies killed. +0.3 damage.
effects: Restores a Half Red Heart for every 13 enemies killed.
+0.3 damage.

items.name: C Section
items.description: Replaces tears with fetuses that chase down enemies and deal contact damage. Each shot requires a brief charge up.
effects: Isaac gains a short delay charge attack that fires homing, piercing, spectral fetus tears.

items.name: Candy Heart
items.description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he heals with Red Heart pickups.
effects: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart healed with Red Heart pickups or when gaining an extra filled heart container:
Spawns a Red Heart when picked up.

items.name: Capricorn
items.description: Adds 1 Red Heart container, gives +0.5 Damage, +0.1 Speed, +0.75 Range, and +0.5 Fire Rate, and gives 1 Bomb, Penny, and Key.
effects: Adds 1 Red Heart container.
+0.5 Damage.
+0.1 Speed.
+0.75 Range.
+0.5 Fire Rate.
+1 Bomb, Penny, and Key.

items.name: Broken Shovel
items.description: While held, causes Mom to continuously attempt to stomp on Isaac. Activating makes her stop for the current room or wave. One of two parts necessary to create Mom's Shovel.

items.name: Buddy in a Box
items.description: Spawns a familiar with a random tear effect. The familiar is randomized at the start of each floor.
effects: Grants a familiar with random tear effects, fire rate, and damage.
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: Bozo
items.description: +0.1 flat damage, grants a Soul Heart. Enemies can randomly become briefly charmed or feared. Taking damage has a chance to spawn a Rainbow Poop.
effects: +0.1 flat damage.
Grants a Soul Heart.
Enemies may randomly become briefly charmed or feared.
Taking damage has a 5% chance to spawn Rainbow Poop.

items.name: Clicker
items.description: Transforms Isaac into another random character and has 50% chance to remove the last item collected.
effects: Upon use, transforms Isaac into a random character and
Non-tainted characters can only transform into other non-tainted characters, and tainted characters can only transform into other tainted characters.

items.name: Butt Bombs
items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs now cloud up the screen, briefly damaging and confusing all enemies.
effects: Gives the player 5 Bombs.
Bombs now cloud up the screen on detonation, briefly confusing and dealing 10 damage to all enemies in the room.
Counts toward the Oh Crap transformation.

items.name: Brimstone
items.description: Tears are replaced with a blood laser beam that pierces through all enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period.
effects: Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is piercing and spectral, dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.
Tears down: Fire Rate ÷ 3.
Counts toward the Leviathan transformation.

items.name: Clear Rune
items.description: Copies the effect of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the rune. Drops a random rune when first picked up.
effects: Upon use, copies the effects of the rune or soul stone currently held by Isaac.
Drops one random rune upon being picked up for the first time.

items.name: Cone Head
items.description: Grants a Soul Heart. Gives Isaac a chance to ignore any damage taken.
effects: Grants a Soul Heart.
Any damage dealt to Isaac has a 20% chance to be ignored.

items.name: Bucket of Lard
items.description: Grants two Red Heart containers, -0.2 speed.
effects: Adds 2 full Red Heart containers.
-0.2 speed.

items.name: Brown Nugget
items.description: Spawns a stationary fly turret that lasts for the current room and fires tears at nearby enemies.
effects: Spawns a stationary fly turret that shoots at enemies up to 3 tiles away
The flies are completely invulnerable and ignored by enemies.
The flies deal 3.5 damage per shot.
Counts toward the Oh Crap transformation.

items.name: Bumbo
items.description: Spawns a beggar familiar which picks up any nearby coins, leveling up after collecting several coins. At level 2, Bumbo gains a body. At level 3, it begins to fire tears. At level 4, Bumbo follows enemies and gains contact damage.
effects: Spawns a familiar which follows Isaac and picks up any nearby coins. Bumbo changes level based on the amount of coins it's collected.
After reaching level 4, Bumbo will continue to collect coins, and can drop a pickup, trinket, or chest for each coin it collects, similar to Bum Friend.

items.name: Charged Baby
items.description: Spawns a familiar that occasionally drops a Lil' Battery, gives an active item charge, or petrifies all enemies in the room.
effects: Spawns a battery familiar that, while Isaac is in an uncleared room, every 30 seconds, starting from the moment it has been picked up, does one of the following:

items.name: Caffeine Pill
items.description: Grants +0.3 speed, reduces Isaac's size, and gives a random pill.
effects: +0.3 speed.
Decreases Isaac's size, making him less likely to be hit.
Upon pickup, gives Isaac a random pill. If he is already holding a consumable, it is forcibly dropped to the ground.

items.name: Brimstone Bombs
items.description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.
effects: Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.
Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions.

items.name: Breakfast
items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

items.name: Brittle Bones
items.description: Replaces all Red Heart with 6 empty Bone Hearts. Upon losing a Bone Heart, Isaac fires bones in 8 directions and permanently gains a fire rate up.
effects: Grants 6 empty Bone Hearts.
Removes all current Red Heart. Does not remove existing Bone Hearts, but does empty them.
Upon losing a Bone Heart, including ones acquired from other sources, Isaac fires a ring of 8 bones that split into more bones.

items.name: Card Reading
items.description: Spawns two portals at the beginning of each floor that each lead to either the Boss Room, Treasure Room, or Secret Room.
effects: At the beginning of each floor, spawns 2 portals that lead to certain special rooms:
On floors with no treasure rooms or no secret rooms, only 1 portal will spawn.
The portals will disappear once the starting room is left, whether a portal was taken or not.

items.name: Contagion
items.description: The first enemy killed in a room releases a gas cloud that poisons nearby enemies. Affected enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.
effects: In each room, the first enemy killed will release a gas explosion and poison nearby enemies.

items.name: Ceremonial Robes
items.description: Grants 3 Black Hearts and +1 damage.
effects: Grants 3 Black Hearts.
+1 damage.

items.name: Bursting Sack
items.description: Spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac.
effects: Certain spider enemies no longer target or deal contact damage to Isaac, nor actively spawn other enemies. Spiders that are spawned from enemies that are not affected by Bursting Sack will also remain neutral.
Counts toward the Spider Baby transformation.

items.name: Compost
items.description: Doubles Isaac's Blue Flies and Blue Spiders, or spawns one if Isaac has none. Converts pickups in the current room into Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
effects: Upon use, converts pickups within the current room to Blue Flies or Blue Spiders.
Doubles Isaac's current amount of Blue Flies and Spiders.

items.name: Broken Glass Cannon
items.description: Begins with no charges and turns into Glass Cannon when used. Only acquired by taking damage while holding Glass Cannon.
effects: This item is acquired when Isaac takes damage while holding Glass Cannon. It begins with no charges.
Once fully charged, it automatically turns back into Glass Cannon.

items.name: Cain's Other Eye
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and fires tears in random cardinal directions that copy Isaac's tears and tear effects and scale with damage.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and copies all of his tear modifiers/stats (like Incubus), with a 25% damage reduction. It fires randomly in the cardinal directions.

items.name: Dead Cat
items.description: Sets Isaac's Red Heart Containers to 1, but grants 9 extra lives. After dying, Isaac respawns with 1 Red Heart Container in the previous room.
effects: Sets Isaac's Red Heart containers to 1 when being picked up.
Grants 9 extra lives.
The head of Guppy begins following Isaac like a familiar upon pickup but doesn't do anything.
Counts toward the Guppy transformation.

items.name: Dark Arts
items.description: Briefly grants +1 speed and makes Isaac invulnerable and intangible. When the effect ends, destroys all projectiles and damages all enemies Isaac passed through.
effects: When used, Isaac gains +1.0 speed and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2× Isaac's damage plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.

items.name: Dad's Ring
items.description: Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies in contact.
effects: Creates a ring of light around Isaac that petrifies enemies on contact.

items.name: Delirious
items.description: Spawns Delirium as a random friendly boss that fights for Isaac. The boss persists between rooms. The charge time is based on the power of the boss summoned.
effects: Upon use, spawns Delirium in a form of a friendly boss.
Changes the appearance of the current room so it looks like a different chapter.

items.name: Cracked Orb
items.description: Unlocks doors and reveals a random room on the map when Isaac takes damage.
effects: Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:

items.name: Crack the Sky
items.description: Creates five beams of light around the room, dealing high damage to any enemies that touch them.
effects: Upon use, summons five beams of light in random locations on the ground. Each beam lasts for 0.8 seconds and deals large amounts of damage to enemies that touch them. They have a hitbox in a 3×3 cross shape.
The beams tend to gravitate towards the enemies, unlike the original game.
The beams have a high chance to directly target enemies.

items.name: Depression
items.description: Spawns a familiar that leaves a trail of creep that damages enemies at 6 damage per second. Has a chance to spawn damaging beams of light onto enemies that touch the cloud.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of blue creep that damages enemies.
If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging Holy Light beam onto the enemy.

items.name: Curse of the Tower
items.description: Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of XVI - The Tower.
effects: Upon taking damage, spawns six Troll Bombs around the room, similar to the effect of XVI - The Tower.

items.name: Dark Matter
items.description: +1 damage, adds a chance to shoot fear tears.
effects: +1 damage.
Adds a chance to shoot fear tears, causing enemies to run away from Isaac.

items.name: Dark Bum
items.quote: He wants to take your life
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every 1½ Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will give a reward.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every one-and-a-half Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will generate one of the following:
Counts toward the Super Bum transformation.

items.name: D4
items.description: Rerolls all of Isaac's passive items.
effects: Upon use, rerolls each of Isaac's passive items into new ones.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.description: Reveals the map (except the Super Secret Room and Ultra Secret Room) and drops a Soul Heart or random card or rune. While held, increases the chance of finding a Planetarium.
effects: Upon use, reveals the floor layout and all special rooms except the Super Secret Room and Ultra Secret Room and drops either a Soul Heart or a random card or rune. (50% chance of either)
While held, increases the chance of finding a Planetarium by 15%, or 100% if a treasure room has been skipped.

items.name: Crack Jacks
items.quote: HP up. Don't swallow the prize!
items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container and drops a random trinket. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Spawns one random trinket.

items.name: D10
items.description: Replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters.
effects: Upon use, replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters. Each monster type has a specific weaker monster it will transform into. If the monster is already at its weakest level, it usually transforms it into a background critter or kills it outright.

items.name: Cursed Eye
items.description: Grants charged tears that can be fired in a tight burst. Getting hit while charging will teleport Isaac to another room.
effects: Grants charged tears which fires a tight burst of tears. Firing mid-charge will shoot fewer tears depending on the charge time.
Taking damage while mid-charge (holding fire, but not fully charged) will teleport Isaac into another room.

items.name: Cricket's Head
items.description: Increases Damage by 0.5, and increases damage multiplier by ×1.5.
effects: +0.5 Damage.
×1.5 Damage multiplier.

items.name: Cube Baby
items.description: Spawns an ice cube familiar that slides around when walked into. It slows and deals contact damage, freezing monsters it kills.
effects: Spawns an ice cube familiar. It cannot move on its own, but slides around when Isaac walks into it, uses a melee attack on it, or when Isaac or enemies shoot at it.
The familiar damages and slows enemies it touches while moving. It can deal up to 17.5 damage when it collides with enemies, depending on how fast it's moving.
Monsters killed by Cube Baby are frozen.
Cube Baby can block enemy projectiles.
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: D8
items.description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.
effects: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.

items.name: D1
items.description: Duplicates a random pickup in the room. The new pickup may be different than the original (i.e. a different card, etc).
effects: Upon use, duplicates one random pickup in the current room, including Cards, Runes, Chests, and trinkets.
Duplicated pickups may not be identical to the original; for example, a duplicated card may be a different one than the original.

items.name: Dead Sea Scrolls
items.description: Triggers the effect of a random activated item from a list of possible options (not every activated item is included).
effects: Anarchist Cookbook
Best Friend
Bob's Rotten Head
The Book of Belial
Book of Revelations
Book of Shadows
The Book of Sin
Crack the Sky

items.name: Dad's Note
items.description: Sends Isaac on an Ascent toward Home.
effects: Initiates the Ascent sequence.
Any trinkets left in Treasure Rooms and Boss Rooms will turn into Cracked Keys.

items.name: Damocles
items.quote: A king's fortune... but at what cost?
items.description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.
effects: Upon use, summons a sword that hangs directly above Isaac. As long as the sword hangs above Isaac, all item pedestals are doubled, spawning an additional free item next to them.

After Isaac gets hit once with the item activated, at any time with only a brief warning, the sword may fall, instantly killing Isaac regardless of his health. The sword has a 1/10000 chance every 4 game ticks (every 0.133 seconds) to fall, so on average, 50% of all Damocles runs will not drop the sword until after at least 15 minutes and 24 seconds have passed.

items.name: Dead Onion
items.description: Grants piercing and spectral tears. Increases tear size (without increasing damage) while greatly reducing range and shot speed.
effects: Grants piercing and spectral tears.
-1.5 range.
-0.4 shot speed.
+0.22 tear size.

items.name: Dead Eye
items.description: Isaac's damage increases each time an enemy is hit. Damage is reset upon missing a shot.
effects: Isaac's damage increases for each successive tear hit on enemies.

items.name: Deep Pockets
items.description: Increases the coin cap to 999. If a room would otherwise yield no reward, 1-3 coins will spawn.
effects: Increases the coin cap to 999.
If a room would otherwise yield no reward, 1-3 random coins will spawn.

items.name: Dad's Key
items.description: Opens all doors in the current room in almost all circumstances, including doors which require a Key to open, entrances to Secret Rooms, and the door to Mega Satan.
effects: Upon use, opens all doors in the current room in almost all circumstances.

items.name: D100
items.description: Activates the combined effects of D1, D4, The D6, D7, D8, D10, D12, and D20.
effects: Rerolls all passive items on Isaac (like the D4).
Rerolls all pedestal items in the room (like The D6).
Rerolls all pickups in the room (like the D20).
Restarts the room and respawns all enemies (like the D7).
Rerolls Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed (like the D8).
Rerolls all enemies in the room into weaker ones (like the D10).
Rerolls all rocks in the room (like the D12).
Duplicates 1 random pickup in the current room (like the D1).

items.name: Crown Of Light
items.description: +2 Soul Hearts. While Isaac has no empty red hearts, grants 2x damage, -0.3 shot speed,
effects: Grants 2 Soul Hearts.
Replaces normal tears with blue diamond tears while all of Isaac's Red Heart containers and Bone Hearts (if any) are full.
While the effect is active, grants the following stats:
The crown will glow blue while active; if inactive, it will appear grey.
The effect will deactivate for the rest of the current room when damage is taken, regardless of Isaac's health.

items.name: Cube of Meat
items.description: Creates an orbital familiar. Collecting additional copies gives it the ability to shoot tears, then chase enemies to deal contact damage, then deal even more contact damage.
effects: Spawns an orbital familiar around Isaac which blocks shots and deals 52.5 contact damage per second.
Each subsequent Cube of Meat obtained is combined with the first one (increasing its 'level'), changing its characteristics:

items.name: Dataminer
items.description: Displaces enemy sprites for the current room and randomly increases one of Isaac's stats while decreasing another. Turns all items in the room into glitched items with random effects.
effects: Upon use, rotates every enemy and pickup 90 degrees and moves its sprite up and left for the current room.
Increases one of Isaac's stats and decreases another. Possible stat changes include:
Adds random tear effects for the current room.
Distorts the music for the current room.
Rerolls any item in the room to a glitched TMTRAINER item.

items.name: Dad's Lost Coin
items.description: +2.5 range. Drops a Lucky Penny.
effects: +2.5 range.
Drops a Lucky Penny.

items.name: Death Certificate
items.description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
effects: Upon use, transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which has one copy of almost every item the player has unlocked on that save file on pedestals. After taking an item from a pedestal, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.

items.name: D20
items.description: Re-rolls all pickups, chests, and trinkets in the current room.
effects: Upon use, re-rolls all pickups, chests, and trinkets in the current room.

items.name: Dead Tooth
items.description: While firing, Isaac gains a green aura that poisons nearby enemies.
effects: While firing, creates an aura around Isaac that poisons any nearby enemies for 2 ticks.
Poison damage is equal to Isaac's damage stat.

items.name: Daddy Longlegs
items.description: Daddy Long Legs' shadow follows Isaac and occasionally stomps enemies for 40 damage total.
effects: Daddy Long Legs' shadow follows Isaac and stomps on enemies for 20 damage per tick, with each stomp capable of hitting a single enemy twice for a total of 40 damage. The delay between stomps is approximately 4 seconds.
In a room with multiple enemies, Daddy Long Legs will prioritize on monsters with the most health first.
Counts toward the Spider Baby transformation.

items.name: Coupon
items.description: While held, guarantees one item in every Shop will be on sale for half price. On use, makes a random item in the current room free.
effects: Upon use, turns a random item in the current room that costs money or hearts into a pedestal item that can be taken for free.
While held, guarantees a random item or pickup from the Shop to be half price.

items.name: Decap Attack
items.description: Throws Isaac's head, which is still able to fire tears at the spot it lands. Reactivating the item or stepping on the head reattaches it.
effects: Throws Isaac's head while allowing to shoot from the spot it lands, blocking enemy shots as well as dealing contact damage to nearby enemies. Meanwhile, Isaac's body can no longer shoot tears.

items.name: Dead Bird
items.description: After Isaac takes damage, spawns a flying familiar that chases enemies for the current room, dealing ~4 damage per second. As long as Isaac's HP is at one half heart ( no matter the type of heart), Dead Bird will remain active between rooms.
effects: Taking damage summons a bird familiar that chases enemies for the remainder of the current room, dealing 2 damage per tick (~4.3 damage per second).

items.name: Dark Prince's Crown
items.description: When at exactly one Red Heart, +2 fire rate, +1.5 range, and +0.2 shot speed.
effects: When at exactly 1 Red Heart, some of Isaac's stats are increased.
The effect is lost any time Isaac gains or loses Red Hearts.

items.name: Cupid's Arrow
items.description: Grants Isaac triangular piercing tears that travel through enemies (but not obstacles) instead of breaking on impact with them.
effects: Grants piercing tears that travel through enemies (but not obstacles) instead of breaking on impact with them.

items.name: Cricket's Body
items.description: When tears hit an object or deplete their range, they spawn 4 smaller tears, whose range and damage scale with Isaac's. Grants +0.5 fire rate and reduces range.
effects: When Isaac's normal tears disappear (either from hitting the ground or hitting something else), they spawn 4 smaller tears.
+0.1 tear size.
+0.5 fire rate.
0.8x range multiplier.

items.name: Crooked Penny
items.description: Has a 50% chance to double all items, Chest, trinkets, and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, spawns a Penny and the other items and pickups disappear.
effects: Upon use, has a 50% chance to double all items, pickups, trinkets, and Chest in the current room.

items.name: Demon Baby
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and automatically fires at enemies within its range.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and automatically fires normal tears at enemies in its range 3 times per second that each do 3.5 damage.
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: D12
items.description: Re-rolls most types of obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.
effects: Re-rolls obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.

Obstacles can reroll into: Rocks, Tinted rocks, Cobwebs, Chapter-specific obstacles (Urns, Mushrooms, Skulls, and Polyps), Metal Blocks, Trap doors, Crawl Spaces, TNT, White Poop, Fool's Gold Rocks, Reward Plates and Killswitches.
Rerolled obstacles will only reroll into another one in this group: Poops, Retractable Spikes, Normal and Red Fire Places, both types of TNT, and Cobwebs.

items.name: D infinity
items.description: Replicates the effect of a selected die item (except Spindown Dice), and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.
effects: Upon use, acts as any die item except for Spindown Dice, and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.

items.name: D7
items.description: Restarts the current room and respawns all monsters, allowing more rewards to be acquired by completing the room.
effects: Upon use, it restarts the room and respawns all monsters. Normal room clear awards are generated.

items.name: Dead Dove
items.description: Grants spectral tears and flight.
effects: Grants spectral tears and flight.
Counts toward the Seraphim transformation.

items.name: Death's Touch
items.description: +1.5 damage, -0.3 tears. Tears are replaced with large piercing scythes.
effects: +1.5 damage
-0.3 tears
Grants piercing tears.
Tear size multiplier: 2x.
Tears are replaced by Death's scythes.

items.name: Deck of Cards
items.description: Gives Isaac a random card.
effects: Gives Isaac a random card.
If all of Isaac's card slots are full, the card given by the Deck of Cards is placed in the first slot, dropping the card that was in it on the ground.

items.name: Death's List
items.description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.
effects: Upon entering a room, a skull appears over an enemy's head.

items.name: Empty Heart
items.description: If Isaac has one red heart or fewer at the beginning of a floor, he gains an empty red heart container.
effects: If Isaac has one red heart or less at the beginning of a floor, an empty heart container is added.

items.name: Epiphora
items.description: Shooting in one direction increases Isaac's rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as Isaac changes direction or stops shooting, rate of fire is reset to its normal amount.
effects: Fire rate gradually increases by intervals as the player shoots in one direction. Accuracy also decreases as the fire rate increases.
The time required to reach max charge is 6 seconds.
Rate of fire returns to its original value if Isaac stops firing, changes firing directions, uses an active item, or is hit.

items.name: Fate
items.description: Grants flight and one Eternal Heart.
effects: Grants flight and one Eternal Heart.

items.name: Flush!
items.description: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop. Instantly kills poop-themed bosses. Floods the current room.
effects: Turns all non-boss monsters in the room into Poop.
Floods the whole room with water (same effect as seen in Flooded Caves).
Instantly kills most poop-themed bosses (Dingle, Dangle, Brownie, Clog, and Turdlings).
Extinguishes all Normal and Red Fire Places in the room.
Turns lava-filled pits in the Mines into solid rock, allowing them to be walked over.
Counts toward the Oh Crap transformation.

items.name: Dry Baby
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a chance of triggering The Necronomicon effect.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a 25% chance of triggering The Necronomicon effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room. This effect of the familiar has a cooldown of 150 frames.
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: Esau Jr.
items.description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.
effects: When used, swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has three Black Hearts, +2 flat damage, and flight. When used as Esau Jr., swaps back to the original character.

Coins, Bombs, and Keys are shared between the two characters, but everything else (including hearts, items, cards/pills, and trinkets) are not shared and apply only to the character that collects them.
When used for the first time, Esau Jr. gains a random item for each item the original character had. Each new item comes from the same item pool the respective original item was taken from.
If either character dies, they both die, regardless of whether the other character has any remaining health.

If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a familiar that behaves like Abel but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.

items.name: Finger!
items.description: Spawns a finger familiar that faces in the same direction as Isaac, rapidly damaging enemies it points at for 10% of Isaac's damage.
effects: Spawns a floating finger familiar that can be aimed with the fire buttons in all directions.

items.name: Evil Charm
items.description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.
effects: Gives Isaac +2.0 luck.
Makes Isaac immune to:
Isaac can stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

items.name: Eye of Belial
items.description: Grants piercing tears. After piercing one enemy, tears start homing and deal double damage.
effects: +1.5 range.
Grants piercing tears.
After piercing one enemy, tears will gain double damage, homing, and a 1.3x size multiplier.

items.name: Everything Jar
items.description: Spawns certain pickups based on how many charges it has. If fully charged, instead has one of many unique effects.
effects: Everything Jar can be activated while not fully charged.
If the item is not fully charged, it spawns a pickup based on how many charges it had:
If the item is fully charged, it instead has one of the following effects:

items.name: Dog Tooth

effects: +0.3 damage.
+0.1 speed.

A barking sound will play if there is an undiscovered Crawl Space in the room.

items.name: Empty Vessel
items.description: Grants two Black Hearts. While Isaac has no red hearts, grants flight and periodically grants an invincibility shield for a few seconds.
effects: When Isaac has no Red Hearts:
Grants 2 Black Hearts on pickup.

items.name: Eve's Mascara
items.quote: DMG up, tears + shot speed down
items.description: Doubles damage, 0.66x tears multiplier, and greatly reduces shot speed.
effects: 2x damage multiplier.
-0.5 shot speed.
0.66x fire rate multiplier.

items.name: Divine Intervention
items.description: Double tapping a fire key creates a shield that pushes away enemies and reflects enemy projectiles and lasers.
effects: Double tapping a fire key creates a Divine Shield that slowly moves in the chosen direction.
The Divine Shield has a variety of effects.
The shield lasts 1 second and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.
Counts toward the Seraphim transformation.

items.name: Distant Admiration
items.description: Spawns an attack fly that circles further out than Halo of Flies, but closer than Forever alone, dealing 75 damage per second.
effects: Spawns a red attack fly that circles around Isaac, and deals 5 damage per tick or 75 damage per second on contact.
Counts toward the Beelzebub transformation.

items.name: Farting Baby
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots. If a shot hits Farting Baby, it has a chance to fart, which charms, poisons, or knocks back nearby enemies.
effects: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a 25% chance of farting. Farting has a cooldown of 210 frames. There are three possible fart effects:
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: Dinner
items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

items.name: Flat Stone
items.description: Tears bounce off the floor, creating splashes. Splashes deal 25% of Isaac's tear damage to all enemies in a small area.
effects: Tears bounce off the floor as they travel. Whenever a tear bounces, it creates a small splash that deals 25% of Isaac's tear damage to enemies.

items.name: Eucharist
items.description: An Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.
effects: Sets the Angel Deal chance to 100% and the Devil Deal chance to 0% regardless of all other modifiers (except Duality), guaranteeing an Angel Room Door will spawn whenever possible and preventing it from closing.

items.name: Doctor's Remote
items.description: Creates a crosshair on the ground that can be aimed with tear controls. A missile strikes the spot after 2 seconds, creating a heavy damage explosion.
effects: Upon activation, a large red crosshair will appear on the ground. The crosshair can be moved using tear controls.
After approximately 2 seconds, a large missile will land on the red marker. The missile acts like a large bomb explosion, dealing 20 times Isaac's damage (the same as Epic Fetus).

items.name: Eye Sore
items.description: Causes Isaac to occasionally fire extra tears in random directions while shooting.
effects: When Isaac shoots, he has a chance to fire 1-3 additional tears in random directions.

items.name: Dream Catcher
items.description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's Treasure Room, as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.
effects: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the item that will be found in the Treasure Room and what Boss will be at the end of the floor.
Grants a Half Soul Heart upon entering a new floor (this includes each floor of the Ascent).

items.name: E. Coli
items.description: Enemies that touch Isaac are transformed into Poop.
effects: Enemies that touch Isaac are transformed into Poop.
All brown Poops, including those created by E.Coli, now have a 6.25% chance to drop a heart if it normally wouldn't drop anything.
Counts toward the Oh Crap transformation.

items.name: Evil Eye
items.description: Adds a chance to fire a slow-moving eye that fires tears in the same direction as Isaac. The eye is destroyed when it hits an enemy or obstacle.
effects: Isaac will occasionally fire a slow-moving eye with an infinite range that fires tears identical to Isaac's tears.
The eyes fire in the same direction as Isaac.

items.name: Eye of the Occult
items.quote: DMG up + range up + controlled tears
items.description: +1 damage, +2 range, -0.16 shot speed. Isaac's tears can be controlled mid-flight with tear controls.
effects: Firing in a direction causes all of Isaac's tears to move in that direction. Tears will stay in place if a fire button is not being pressed.
+1 damage.
+2.0 range.
-0.16 shot speed.
Counts toward the Leviathan transformation.

items.name: Dr. Fetus
items.description: Tears are replaced by Bombs that benefit from bomb-enhancing effects and slide for a fixed time after being fired.
effects: Tears are replaced with Bombs that explode approximately one second after being fired.

items.name: Fast Bombs
items.description: +7 Bombs. Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly. Bombs will no longer knock each other away.
effects: +7 Bombs.
Removes the delay between bomb placements, allowing them to be placed rapidly.
Fast Bombs inflict no knockback on Isaac's bombs.

items.name: Fanny Pack
items.description: Has a chance to drop a random pickup when Isaac takes damage.
effects: Grants a 50% chance to drop a random Penny, Bomb, Key, or Red Heart whenever Isaac takes damage.

items.name: Diplopia
items.description: Duplicates all pickups and item pedestals in the current room.
effects: Instantly spawns a copy of all pickups and pedestal items on the floor in the current room, then disappears.

items.name: Eye of Greed
items.description: Every 20 tears, Isaac loses 1 Penny and shoots an additional gold tear that petrifies enemies and turns them into gold. Any enemy killed while in this state will drop coins.
effects: Adds a golden tear every 20 tears fired, which causes enemies to turn gold and petrifies them for a few seconds (similar to Midas' Touch) at the cost of one Penny. Golden tears can still be fired if Isaac has no money.

items.name: Explosivo
items.description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.
effects: Isaac's tears have a 25% chance to stick to enemies and explode a few seconds afterward, dealing 60 damage plus Isaac's tear damage.

items.name: Dogma (Item)
items.description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the Holy Mantle effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating Dogma.
effects: Grants flight.
Grants a one-time Holy Mantle-like effect. This effect wears off upon leaving the room.
Prevents Isaac's speed from going under 1.1.
+2 damage.

If Isaac has fewer than six full hearts of health, Isaac is given enough hearts to get to six full hearts, first by restoring empty red heart containers, and then by granting soul hearts if that isn't enough.
On Normal mode, grants The Wafer effect, reducing all damage taken to half a heart.

items.name: Eternal D6
items.description: Re-rolls all items in the room. Each item has a 25% chance to disappear instead.
effects: Upon use, replaces every pedestal item in the current room with other random items corresponding to the current room's item pool.

items.name: Flip
items.description: Item pedestals have a second un-interactable "ghostly" item behind them. Activating will flip the real and ghostly items around. If playing as Tainted Lazarus, also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.
effects: While holding Flip, when Isaac enters a new room containing an item (Treasure Room, Shop, etc.), the item pedestal will have a second "ghostly" item behind it.
Upon use, flips all real / ghostly items around on pedestals, allowing Isaac to collect the ghostly items. Does not affect pedestals that do not contain a ghostly item.
If playing as Tainted Lazarus, activating it also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.

items.name: Eraser
items.description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.
effects: Upon use, Isaac holds an Eraser above his head, which can be thrown in any cardinal direction. Upon hitting a monster, the enemy will be "erased", preventing any of the same enemy from appearing for the rest of the run.
Can only be recharged by entering a new floor. Batteries and most other methods of recharging have no effect.

items.name: Epic Fetus
items.description: Instead of tears, firing creates a crosshair which can be moved freely. A missile is dropped in the location after 1.5 seconds, exploding for high damage.
effects: Isaac's tears are replaced with guided missiles. Pressing the fire buttons spawns a crosshair that can be moved freely, dropping a missile on its position from above 1.5 seconds later.

items.name: Euthanasia
items.description: Adds a luck-based chance to fire needles that instantly kill basic enemies and deal triple damage to bosses. If a needle kills an enemy, it bursts into more tears/needles.
effects: Adds a chance to fire needles which deal triple Isaac's tear damage.
Counts toward the Spun transformation.

items.name: Dirty Mind
items.description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.
effects: Converts all enemy Dips and Drips into Dip Familiars.
Rocks have a chance to be replaced with poop when generated.
Destroying Poops spawn 1-4 Dip Familiars, which loosely follow Isaac around, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies.
Destroying different types of poop will spawn special Dips:
Poops unique to Tainted ??? and IBS also spawn Dips with special effects:
Counts toward the Oh Crap transformation.

items.name: Eye Drops
items.description: Increases the fire rate in Isaac's left eye, causing his eyes to fire at different rates.
effects: Increases the fire rate of tears fired from Isaac's left eye by 40%.

items.name: False PHD
items.description: Converts good pills into bad pills and identifies all pills. Bad pills now have secondary positive effects. Grants one Black Heart.
effects: Identifies all pills upon pickup.
Spawns a pill.
Grants one Black Heart on pickup.
Converts all good pills into their bad counterparts.
Grants +0.6 damage for each stat down pill and +1.2 damage for each stat down horse pill Isaac has taken, including those taken before acquiring False PHD.
Using a non-stat down bad pill drops a Black Heart.

items.name: Fire Mind
items.description: Grants flaming tears that deal burning damage over time. Tears have a chance to explode on impact with an enemy, which creates a fire at the location of the explosion.
effects: Tears inflict burn to enemies.
Tears have a chance to explode on impact with an enemy, leaving behind a fire.
Isaac gives a wide glow lighting up dark areas, such as those under the effects of the Darkness or the Dark One's attacks.

items.name: Experimental Treatment
items.quote: Some stats up, some stats down
items.description: Randomly increases and decreases some of Isaac's stats. Increases four random stats and decreases the other two.
effects: Randomly increases at least 1 and decreases 1-3 of Isaac's stats. The same stats can be increased/decreased multiple times.
Randomly increases 4 and decreases 2 of Isaac's stats.
Each increase or decrease for a stat will change it by a fixed value:
If a stat that is already at an upper or lower limit is chosen, there is no visible effect.
Counts toward the Spun transformation.

items.name: Dessert
items.description: Grants one full Red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects: Grants one full Red Heart container.
Heals 1 additional Red Heart.

items.name: Duality
items.description: Whenever a Devil Room or Angel Room would spawn after defeating a boss, both rooms spawn. Only one can be entered.
effects: Whenever a Devil Room/Angel Room spawns after defeating a boss, the other will also spawn.

items.name: Echo Chamber
items.quote: I can see see the future future future
items.description: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.
effects: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.

items.name: Fate's Reward
items.description: A blue head familiar that will follow Isaac and fire tears copying his tear effects and damage.
effects: Spawns a familiar that fires tears with the same damage and tear effects as Isaac's tears.
Fires at half the normal fire rate of a familiar.
The familiar is not affected by tear height; only tear falling speed.

items.name: Divorce Papers
items.description: Grants one Bone Heart, +0.7 tears, spawns a Mysterious Paper.
effects: Grants one Bone Heart.
+0.7 tears.
Spawns Mysterious Paper if it has been unlocked and not previously encountered during the run.

items.name: Dull Razor
items.description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.
effects: Hurts Isaac without taking away health, giving him invincibility frames equal to a full heart damage and activating any items that trigger upon getting hit.

items.name: Eden's Soul
items.description: Spawns two random items from the current room's Item Pool and then disappears. Starts with no charges.
effects: Upon use, spawns two random item pedestals using the item pool of the current room. Eden's Soul is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.

items.name: Eden's Blessing
items.quote: Tears up + your future shines brighter
items.description: +0.7 tears up. Grants a random item at the start of the next run.
effects: +0.7 tears up.
Grants a random item at the start of the next run.

items.name: Haemolacria
items.description: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into many smaller tears in all directions. Increases tear delay.
effects: Turns Isaac's tears into large blood tears fired in an arc. Upon hitting the floor, an obstacle, or an enemy, they burst into smaller tears in all directions.
Tear Delay × 2 + 11
+1 damage and 1.5× damage multiplier.
Range down: 0.8× range multiplier.
The main tear has a roughly 1.71× size multiplier.

items.name: Habit
items.description: When Isaac is hit, his active item gains 1 room's worth of charge.
effects: When Isaac is hit, his active item gains 1 room's worth of charge.

items.name: Guillotine
items.quote: DMG + tears up. An out-of-body experience!
items.description: Isaac's head becomes an orbital familiar that blocks shots and deals contact damage. Tears are still fired from the rotating head. +1 damage, +0.5 fire rate.
effects: Isaac's head becomes an orbital familiar that blocks shots and deals contact damage. Tears are still fired from the rotating head.
+1 damage.

effects: Spawns a pool of Lemonade similar to the Lemon Party pill effect underneath Isaac.

items.name: Guppy's Hairball
items.description: Spawns a familiar that loosely follows behind Isaac, which blocks shots and can be swung like a flail to damage enemies. Grows bigger by killing enemies.
effects: Spawns a hairball familiar that loosely follows behind Isaac, blocks shots, and can be swung like a flail to damage enemies.
Counts toward the Guppy transformation.

items.name: Guppy's Eye
items.description: Shows the contents of Chests, Fire Places, Grab Bags, and Shopkeepers before they're opened/destroyed.

items.name: Glitter Bombs

effects: Grants 5 Bombs.

Isaac's bombs have a 15% chance to charm random enemies in the room when they explode.

items.name: Gemini (Item)
items.description: Spawns a conjoined familiar which chases enemies close to Isaac, dealing ~6.43 damage per second.
effects: Spawns a conjoined familiar, much like Gemini's small twin, Suture. It chases enemies close to Isaac, dealing 3 damage per tick (~6.43 damage per second).

items.name: Friend Zone
items.description: Spawns a white attack fly that orbits somewhere between Distant Admiration and Forever alone, dealing 45 damage per second.
effects: Spawns a white fly familiar that slowly orbits Isaac and deals 3 damage per tick or 45 damage per second on contact.
Counts toward the Beelzebub transformation.

items.name: Fruity Plum
items.description: Gives Isaac a miniature Baby Plum familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.
effects: Gives Isaac a familiar that mimics Baby Plum's attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room. It deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies (6 per second). It fires 15 tears per second behind itself while moving which deals 3 damage.

items.name: Forget Me Now
items.description: Restarts the current floor with a new layout. Any items and pickups from the original floor are kept.
effects: On use, the current floor will be completely re-generated and Forget Me Now will be removed from Isaac's inventory.

items.name: Hallowed Ground
items.description: Spawns a white poop familiar, which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt. White poop has an aura that increases tear fire rate and can block enemy shots. The aura also increases damage by 20% and gives homing.
effects: Spawns a white poop familiar which turns into a White Poop when Isaac is hurt.
The familiar will respawn after Isaac leaves the room.
This item belongs to the set. Collecting three items from this set will transform Isaac into a walking pile of poop.

items.name: Golden Razor
items.description: Spends 5 Penny to grant +1.2 damage for the current room. Grants 5 pennies when picked up for the first time.
effects: Upon use, spends 5 Penny and grants +1.2 damage for the current room.
Grants 5 pennies upon being picked up for the first time.

items.name: Guppy's Paw
items.description: Converts one Red Heart Container into three Soul Hearts.
effects: Upon use, converts one Red Heart Container into three Soul Hearts.
Counts toward the Guppy transformation.

items.name: Head of Krampus
items.description: Fires a powerful Brimstone beam in four cardinal directions. Has a 50% chance to rotate all beams around Isaac 90 degrees.
effects: Upon use, fires a powerful Brimstone beam in the four cardinal directions, similar to that of the attack used by The Fallen and Krampus.

items.name: Goat Head
items.description: A Devil Room / Angel Room will always spawn after every boss fight, excluding the first floor and floors after Chapter 4.
effects: Sets the Devil Room chance to 100% regardless of all other modifiers, guaranteeing a Devil Room or Angel Room Door will spawn whenever possible and remain open.

items.name: Freezer Baby
items.description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and fires icicles have a chance to petrify enemies and freeze monsters they kill.
effects: Spawns a familiar who follows Isaac around and fires icicles once every 0.75 seconds that each do 3.5 damage and have a chance to petrify enemies they hit and freeze enemies they kill.
Counts toward the Conjoined transformation.

items.name: Glaucoma
items.description: Adds a chance to shoot tears that confuse enemies for an extremely long time.
effects: Adds a 5% chance to shoot concussive tears, causing enemies to walk around randomly.
Makes the screen darker.

items.name: Friend Finder
items.description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.
effects: On use, spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks, similar to Jacob and Esau.
Friendly monsters can take damage from flames, spikes, and other hazards.

items.name: God's Flesh
items.description: Tears have a chance to shrink enemies, making them run away from Isaac. Shrunk enemies can be crushed and killed by walking over them.
effects: Tears now have a 20% chance to apply a shrinking effect, causing enemies to shrink in size and also run away from Isaac.
The shrinking effect lasts 5 seconds and enemies will flash white when the effect is about to end.
Counts toward the Fun Guy transformation.

items.name: Growth Hormones
items.description: +1 damage, +0.2 speed.
effects: +1 damage.
+0.2 speed.
